target_customer: Developers and non-engineers such as QA, product and support staff who test APIs
problem: API tools such as Postman are developer oriented and heavy, so non-engineers cannot easily test APIs without help.
business_model: open source developer tool (monetization not stated by sources)

founders.name: Samuel San
founders.background_notes: YC page lists product manager roles at Coinbase and Apple and internships at Meta, Microsoft and Shopify.

founders.name: Jeane
founders.background_notes: Named as cofounder in the YC launch post (surname not given), which says the first version of RecipeUI was built at Robinhood.

competitors.name: Postman
competitors.what: Dominant API client and collaboration platform that RecipeUI positioned itself against

technical_complexity.rationale: A forms-based API client with YAML import is a standard desktop and web app.

defensibility.rationale: Open source, free alternatives such as Insomnia and Hoppscotch existed, and Postman could add simpler forms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Postman and open source clients stayed dominant. No acquisition of RecipeUI was found.

market_need_then: Postman was widely criticized by 2023 for becoming heavier and account-gated, which opened room for lightweight open source clients, though this was not documented in a source dated 2023 that I opened.

branding.domain_note: Company site recipeui.com could not be fetched (HTTP 402).

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and capability focused: enable anyone to test APIs in seconds with a click (YC launch post).

branding.brand_signature: Recipes as the concept for shareable example API calls
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch on 2023-09-05 and about 1.3 thousand GitHub stars (undated aggregator figure).

brand_strength.rationale: A concept-based name with a clear Recipes idea but a name that collides with many recipe and UI kit results, and little brand press.

outcome_analysis: RecipeUI launched an open source Postman alternative with YC in Summer 2023 and a Product Hunt launch in September 2023. YC lists it as active with two people, but AlternativeTo reports the GitHub repository was archived in February 2024 while SourceForge shows a 2025 update, so the current state is unclear. No verified funding, exit or post-mortem was found, which makes the real outcome uncertain and likely a stalled or dormant project.
notes: Company website returned HTTP 402 and was not read. CB Insights reports a 500K convertible note from YC dated 2023-01-01, a single aggregator figure, so it is not recorded as a round. Archive and discontinued status come from AlternativeTo only. YC lists the team location as San Francisco in one view and New York in search snippets. The round rests on a single database (VCBacked, September 2023, 500K USD, YC); CB Insights dates a 500K convertible note to 2023-01-01, conflicting date, so one round is recorded.
